mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.patient_no, p.name, p.gender, p.birth_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, p.phone, p.diagnose_date, p.allergy, p.comorbidity, p.risk_level, p.status, p.doctor_id, d.real_name AS doctor_name, p.last_visit_date, p.next_visit_date, p.remark, p.update_time FROM patient p LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = p.doctor_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.patient_id, b.first_attack, b.exam_result, b.risk_basis, b.register_doctor_id, u.real_name AS register_doctor_name, b.register_date FROM patient_baseline b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = b.register_doctor_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.patient_id = #{patientId}
SELECT id, field_name, before_value, after_value, operator_name, change_time FROM patient_change_log WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY change_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high_risk, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'FOLLOWING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS following, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue FROM patient p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
